description: Java class CobaltA11yHelper extending ExploreByTouchHelper to create a virtual D-pad grid for accessibility support in Cobalt, enabling TalkBack functionality with virtual views and handling key events.

classes.name: CobaltA11yHelper
classes.description: A helper class for accessibility that creates a virtual D-pad grid for Cobalt, supporting TalkBack navigation and injecting key events.

methods.name: CobaltA11yHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the helper with a view and setting accessibility delegate.

methods.name: getVirtualViewAt
methods.description: Returns HOST_ID for any x,y coordinate, as touch/mouse support is not implemented.

methods.name: getVisibleVirtualViews
methods.description: Populates the list with virtual view IDs (1 to 9).

methods.name: focusOnCenter
methods.description: Sets accessibility focus to the center virtual view and then moves the actual focus after a delay.

methods.name: maybeInjectEvent
methods.description: Injects a directional key event based on the currently focused virtual view ID.

methods.name: onPopulateNodeForVirtualView
methods.description: Defines bounds and text for each virtual view; manages focus and event injection when focus changes.

methods.name: onPerformActionForVirtualView
methods.description: Stub method returning false; no custom actions performed.
